fullTextZH: 你好！今天我要说一个人，
fullTextEN: Hello! Today I want to talk about a person,

fullTextZH: 一天有一个男人给我打电话☎️对 ，
fullTextEN: One day a man called me, right,
I want to find a Chinese teacher,
My child wants to learn Chinese,

fullTextZH: 你可以给我的孩子很多很多作业(homework)吗？
fullTextEN: Can you give my child a lot of homework?

fullTextZH: 他说：如果我的孩子不做作业，
fullTextEN: He said: If my child doesn't do homework,
I don't want to hit him,

fullTextZH: 你可以带我的孩子去剪头发吗 ？
fullTextEN: Can you take my child to get a haircut?

fullTextZH: 剪头发?我觉得这不是我的工作，
fullTextEN: Haircut? I think this is not my job,

fullTextZH: 我的工作是教你的孩子中文，
fullTextEN: My job is to teach your child Chinese,
not to take him for a haircut,

fullTextZH: 可是孩子的妈妈不在澳大利亚，
fullTextEN: but the child's mother is not in Australia,

fullTextZH: 所以你可以做孩子妈妈的工作吗 ？
fullTextEN: so can you do the child's mother's job?
I said: Ah! No, I can't,
My job is a Chinese teacher,
I don't want to do a mother's job.

fullTextZH: 对，所以有一个爸爸给我打电话，
fullTextEN: Right, so a father called me,

fullTextZH: 然后他说他要一个中文老师，
fullTextEN: Then he said he wanted a Chinese teacher,

fullTextZH: 他的孩子很多很多作业，对，
fullTextEN: his child a lot of homework, right,
If the child doesn't do homework,

fullTextZH: 还有我要带他的孩子去剪头发，
fullTextEN: and I will take his child for a haircut,

fullTextZH: 因为孩子的妈妈不在澳大利亚，
fullTextEN: Because the child's mother is not in Australia,

fullTextZH: 所以我也要做妈妈的工作，
fullTextEN: so I also have to do the mother's work,
I find it very, very strange,

fullTextZH: 这个爸爸真的在找一个中文老师，
fullTextEN: Is this father really looking for a Chinese teacher,

fullTextZH: 还是他在找孩子的妈妈，
fullTextEN: or is he looking for the child's mother,

fullTextZH: 你觉得这个爸爸在找什么？
fullTextEN: What do you think this father is looking for?

fullTextZH: 中文老师还是孩子的妈妈？
fullTextEN: A Chinese teacher or the child's mother?
Leave a comment to tell me,
